book.name: Luk
book.title: LUK Kamambuno Wakai Luk Muno Boglkwa

content: Ambu werai ta ka tange teingwa yomba akeple ditenambere pre, Yesus ka di simbogl dungwa
Yesus ka suwarata di simbogl disaipelma wagle bekete, te ye kamange engenge ertre ana oglka erekraglkwa pre ombuno ditongwa.
Ye dungwa, “Taun suna ka tange teingwa yomba ta moglkwa, ye God kunduglmo goglkre ana yomba kanwakai yeikrukwa.

Ana ambu werai ta taun suna igle moglkwa ye eremogl ka tange teingwa yomba moglmara engenge undre, akeple dinambedi pre dungwa, ‘Na kundana ikine erekinde ere nara erikwa, ana ene kot mina na akepledo.’
“Enge olto ka tange teingwa yomba akeple ditenakrukwa ba okuwo kaima yene nomane siprukwa, ‘Na God kunduglmo goglkre ana yomba kanwakai yeikrika.
Ba ambu werai i yumbun engenge narkwa pre na kot mina akeple ditenaglka. Ana ye engenge wu moran okuwo na oglka ere dinaglka.’”
Ana Yaglkande dungwa, “Ene eremogl ka tange teingwa yomba kinde ka dungwa i piryo.
God pinde yungwa yomba ermine ya enduwer engenge kai erete meglmbi ana ye akeple dikrambo? Ana God aimande ye kanwinge erambo?
Na ene diteinga, ye eraglkwa i kandre tambre akeple dinambuka. Ba Yomba Wam unambuka enge, makandle yomba pirngi dimo mo dikrikwa i ye kanambo?”
Parisi ya takis ingwa yomba pre ka diboglkwa
Yomba tau yene pre yomba du-yene mounedi pirtre ana yomba prapra kan i taragl yoko mere endingwa. Erikwa ipre Yesus ka i di simbogl dungwa,
“Yagl suwo kamange era pre ende yenda God holi yungumo mina embrika, ta Parisi te ta takis yungwa yomba.

Ana Parisi andigltre, yene pre kamange orkwa, ‘God, na ene diwakai yeinga, sraglpre na yomba tau meglmere yeglmere na ta moglkrika. Kunogl ne, embriye kinde ere, ambu kunogl gundo, te takis yungwa yagle moglmere yegl na ta moglkrika.
Na wakan suwarata mina ande enge suwondi kaiya mokna mawagl ertre, te na taragl prapra inga i yumbu sindre 10 mina suwarata God teinga.’
“Ba takis yungwa yagle eglke dagl andigl mogltre, ana ye kan mina heven endinambuka mere mango, ye piuriye tagla sindre ana dungwa, ‘God, na mitna goglo, na tandaglme erika yomba.’

“Na ene diteinga, yagl takis yungwa i ye ende ikine yungumugl enan, ana ye God ongumuglo mina yomba du-wakai morambuka, te yomba prapra yene kangino ake mitna endingwa i God ake atne endinambuka, ana yomba ta yene kangiye ake atne ende wangwa i God ake mitna imbo endinambuka.”
Yesus eremogl gak kembra blesing tongwa
Yesus eremogl gak kembra God wakai ere tenambedi dungwa pre yomba auro i yu ye moglmara wingwa. Ba disaipelma wagle i kandre, ye yomba ka-teingwa.

Ba Yesus gak kembra aglendi ye moglmara ende ana dungwa, “Ene kan winge erimbi gak kembra na moglmara wiyondo, ana ene ye i-teke pandiglkriyo. Sraglpre, God kingdom imbo gak kembra yeglmere moraglkwa ye pre yongwa.
Na ka kaima ene diteinga, yomba ta God kingdomo gak kembra yeglmere ta ikran ana ye suna i kaima ta pikrambuka.”
Yagl ta taragl mere paitongwa Yesus bogl denbi dimbrika
Juda yagl kande suwarata krapogl Yesus te yegl dungwa, “Beke Notnga wakai, na sragl ere kor aimande moraglka inagle?”
Ana Yesus krapogl tongwa, “Sraglpre ene na wakai we dine? Yomba wakai ta moglkrikwa, ba God suwara wakai moglkwa.
Ene ka lo prapra pitnga, ambu kunogl gundokro, yomba ta sigoglkro, kunogl gogl nekro, kakimbi dikro, ana nen ya man dinambrere ero.”
Ana ye di ikine endungwa, “Na yagl gak kembra moglka enge lo i prapra sika singa.”

Yesus ka i pirtre ana yagle i ditongwa, “Ene taragl suwara kaima ta ama eratnga yoko pangwa. Taragl kan nenga prapra topo bogl indre, ana moni ipi kiuglgiunde yomba to. Ana ene heven suna taragl wakai mere paitenambuka, yegl ertre ana okuwo na wimara wo.”
Ye ka i pirtre ana kinde kaima prukwa, sraglpre, ye taragl pond ake-nongwa yagle.
Yesus kango yagle i kinde pruko ana ye dungwa, “Yomba taragl merkinde paitongwa ye yombuglo ere ende God kingdomo mina suna enamunedi erimbi manambuka.
Kaima, bugla-kamel kar kuiye mina ende suna enan kuno erambuka, ba yomba taragl mere paitongwa ende God kingdomo mina suna enamunedi erimbi manambuka.”
Yomba tau ka i pirtre krapeglkwa, “Okuwo ira kor aimande moraglkwa inambe?”
Ana Yesus di ikine endungwa, “Taragl yomba eraglkwa kuno erekrukwa i God erambuka kuno orkwa.”
Pita di Yesus tongwa, “Kano! No taratno prapra kindekondo ene unara umga.”
Yesus di ye tongwa, “Na ka kaima ene diteinga, yomba suwarata yungumo mo, embiye mo, angiglma mo, nem mam mo, nangiglma, i God kingdomo pre ere kinde kondinan,
ana God taragl merkinde kaima erme tenan indre ana okuwo enge ta unambuka enge ye kor aimande morambuka inambuka.”
Yesus gorambuka pre aglke dungo, enge suwota orkwa
Yesus disaipelma wagle 12 ikoglo ende ana prapra ditongwa, “Piryo, nono ende yenda Jerusalem enamga. Ana igle Yomba Wam pre, propet wagle ka muno beglkwa pangwa i pai inambuka.
Ye tekoglo Yomba Bina meglmara endinaglkwa. Ana ye bakagl tendre, kinde ere tendre, kimbi ditendre, eursi tendre, uglmbo kumba sindre, ana sigoraglkwa.
Ba ande enge suwota mina aglke andigl ukor enambuka.”
Ana disaipelma wagle ye ka dungwa i ta pirpogl sikrikwa, ka dungwa i mambunomo ye mina wu pene pikrukwa. Ana ye sraglpre ka dungwa i disaipelma wagle ta pirpogl sikrikwa.
Yagl ta ongumuglo kin yongo taragl yana di-di orkwa, Yesus erewakai orkwa
Yesus ende Jeriko mangigl ungo, yagl suwarata ongumuglo kin yongwa konbauna menda kra amedi mogl taragl yana di moglkwa.
Enge igle ye prukwa yomba merkinde ende wopi dingo pre ye sragl orumda di krapoglkwa.
Ana yomba eremogl ye ditengwa, “Yesus Nasaret nem mangigl ende wongwa ya.”
Ana yagle i agle binan bogl dungwa, “Yesus, Devit Wam, ene na mitna goglo!”
Ana yomba tau okuna kana wingwa ka-tendre, ana kiendi moglo diteingwa ba yagle agle binan bogl di paimoglkwa, “Devit Wam, ene na mitna goglo!”
Ana Yesus andigl mogltre, ana yomba dite yagle i auro yu ye moglmara ya wiyo dungwa. Ye ende mangigl ungo, ana Yesus krapogl tongwa,
“Ene na sragl ere narambedi pitne?” Ye di ikine endungwa, “Yaglkande na ongumutna kanagledi pirka.”
Yesus di ye tongwa, “Ene ongumutn pinedi kano. Ene pirngi dinara enene ongumutn wakai orkwa.”
Oglandi kaima ye ongumuglo pinedi kandre, ana Yesus omara pindre God dembiye sungwa. Ana yomba prapra i kandre, ye ama God dembiye singwa.
